recommended_route: Selected recorded-health bar/numeric value plus discrete native timepoints. Actual real snapshots are not a continuous health history.

verdict.real_selected_event_health_bar: YES conditionally: explicit accepted own recapID; public finite currentHP and same-record recap maxHealth. Native UI already computes this ratio.
verdict.real_event_sampled_health_ribbon: YES to discrete recorded timepoints only when rawHP/max ratio is valid. Do not connect live native snapshots as a complete health history; retain gaps.
verdict.complete_continuous_HP_or_healing_histor: NO verified source contract: no complete heal stream, per-event maximum or intrahit before/after semantics.
verdict.live_health_bar_without_secret_branching: YES display-only via native StatusBar secret-capable setters; this is not a historical data API.
verdict.guaranteed_public_finite_history_from_li: NO: UnitHealth/Percent are declared secret; curves do not declassify. A bounded history would need new opt-in capture and native validation, outside current alpha29 preview fix.

minimum_capture.identity: Reuse the existing explicit accepted own-personal recapID and association guards. Never use a newly selected/default or prior record as current.
minimum_capture.attempts: Reuse existing <=3 native fetch attempts; no separate polling/retry subsystem.
minimum_capture.field_guards: Public plain parent/row; issecretvalue false before type/value inspection; finite numeric currentHP>=0 and finite recapMaxHealth>0. Do not map nil/secret/malformed to0.
minimum_capture.scale_rule: This is ONE recap-level max for every event, matching native UI. It is not verified per-event maximum health.
minimum_capture.ratio_rule: For a bar on the recap scale, require0<=currentHP<=recapMaxHealth. Use currentHP/recapMaxHealth. If out of scale, keep the valid raw HP readout but do not silently clamp it or imply100%.
minimum_capture.partial_rule: Keep damage/event data when HP is missing. A single bad HP field does not invalidate an otherwise accepted recap.
minimum_capture.zero_rule: Public0 is a recorded value; never append a zero endpoint merely because PLAYER_DEAD fired.
minimum_capture.timing_rule: Use only each event timestamp within the accepted native record; no assumed GetTime/live-sample alignment.
minimum_capture.additional_scope_limits: Existing verified explicit own recapID only. No new events/polling/session-association changes. Keep raw recordedHP independent of maxHealth.

renderer_input_shape.origin: native_recap | example (Example must remain visible on every fictional fixture)
renderer_input_shape.recapID: accepted real ID; absent for Example
renderer_input_shape.recapMaxHealth: public number or null, frozen once for this record

snapshots.hpSemantics: Health reported with this event; before/after-hit unspecified
snapshots.scaleSemantics: Fraction of recap maxHealth, not verified event-specific maxHealth

product_copy.gap: Health was not recorded for this event.
product_copy.scale_tooltip: Scaled to the max health supplied with this recap.
do_not_claim: healing received from positive HP deltas
real live data for an Example fixture

live_signal_facts.UnitHealth: UnitHealth(player,false); SecretReturns=true; usePredicted defaults true, so false is required for an unpredicted observation.
live_signal_facts.UnitHealthPercent: UnitHealthPercent(player,false,curve?); SecretReturns=true and SecretWhenCurveSecret=true; percentage can feed native display without Lua arithmetic.
live_signal_facts.events: UNIT_HEALTH/UNIT_MAXHEALTH have unitTarget only, no historical HP payload; SynchronousEvent/UniqueEvent are not a guarantee of one sample per hit/heal.
live_signal_facts.sinks: StatusBar:SetValue/SetMinMaxValues accept secret arguments; GetValue/GetMinMaxValues return secret for BarValue aspect. Readback is not a public-data route.
live_signal_facts.curve: CurveConstants.ScaleTo100 maps0..1 to0..100 for display; it does not reveal protected input.
live_signal_facts.history_limit: No history object/getter is supplied by these verified APIs. Retaining/replaying opaque samples as display-only history requires a separately scoped native spike; no public numeric/export claim.

native_acceptance_required: Explicit current own recapID/association; nil/secret/zero/out-of-scale HP/max cases; show gaps without replacing values
Compare recorded snapshot/rawHP and native tooltip percent against the Blizzard recap for the same record; determine before/after with controlled hit/heal tests before ever adding that wording
Temporary max-health change verifies fixed recap denominator behavior; do not call it per-event percentage
Heal between damage records demonstrates that missing intermediate HP/heals cannot be reconstructed

If future live collection is authorized: bound own-player sampling/retention, verify usePredicted=false, capture-time/max changes, secret storage/render replay permissions and local/native clock association; no secret arithmetic/readback/export
preview_constraint: All alpha29 fictional examples are explicitly Arcane Mage(spec62). PrismaticBarrier235450; explicitly choose IceBlock45438 OR IceCold414658, not both; AlterTime342245; Healthstone and audited healing potion. This research creates no sample recorder or outgoing-DPS defensive classification.
review_gates: PublicHP0 yields a real0 value, never nil by truthiness.
Missing/secret/negative/nonfiniteHP or missing/secret/nonpositive/nonfinite max never becomes0 or a guessed bar.
RawHP remains readable even without a valid max; HP>max never silently clamps to100%.
MissingHP/max does not reject otherwise valid damage rows.
Selection refresh resets numeric/bar state: switching rows cannot retain the previous HP.
Real ShowLast never trusts sample-looking fields as permission to consume fictional health/healing. Example origin is set only by explicit Preview path.
Native fields keep same-record timestamps and recap-level denominator caveat; no before/after language, damage subtraction, healing inference or local/native clock merge.
Root allowed only the data extraction/rendering extension; recorder/association/marker/media event behavior stays otherwise unchanged.
